# Saved from GPUWorks deployment "olmo" (id 1).
# Verified on 1 x NVIDIA H20.
# Deployment env not exported: HF_TOKEN.
# The spec runs the deployment's manual command; its args do not reach the engine.
# The command writes out deployment env left out of this template (HF_TOKEN); those values are redacted.
# Placement accepts only 1 card(s) on one node: the manual command states its parallelism itself.
# The command set a secret and is redacted: copy it again from the deployment's launch command and write it without the secret before saving this template.
# Missing kv_bytes_per_token for vllm: compute it from config.json
# (scripts/estimate-calib/kv_layout.py) before proposing this template.
# Tested openai.chat: HTTP 200.
models:
    - model_id: allenai/olmo-2-0425-1b-instruct
      source: user
      display_title: OLMo 2 1B
      input_modalities:
        - text
      model_config:
        model_type: olmo2
        num_hidden_layers: 16
        hidden_size: 2048
        num_attention_heads: 16
        num_key_value_heads: 16
      context_length: 4096
      specs:
        - name: vllm-1xnvidia-h20-d1
          scenario: balanced
          engine: vllm
          image: runner:vllm@sha
          weights:
            quantization: bf16
            sources:
                - huggingface:
                    repo_id: allenai/OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct
                    revision: 48d788eca847d4d7548f375ad03d3c9312f6139e
          weight_bytes: 2969854224
          gpus:
            vendor: nvidia
            name: ^NVIDIA H20$
          args:
            - --max-model-len
            - "4096"
            - --gpu-memory-utilization
            - "0.9"
            - --seed
            - "7"
          placement:
            language: starlark
            resolver: |
                def resolve(gpu):
                    if gpu.count != 1 or gpu.nnodes != 1:
                        return reject("the manual command was tested on exactly 1 card(s) of one node")
                    return {}
          api:
            health_endpoint: /health
            operations:
                - request_encoding: json
                  type: openai.chat
                  endpoint: /v1/chat/completions
                  mode: stream
          manual_command: <redacted>
